title: 7 Money Habits That Keep You Broke (And What to Do Instead)
description:
Working hard but always broke at the end of the month? It's usually not your income. It's a few quiet money habits draining your account without you noticing.

In this video, we go through 7 common money habits that keep people broke, and exactly what to do instead: saving first, the 48-hour rule for impulse buys, avoiding lifestyle creep, building a simple budget, using credit cards the smart way, celebrating small wins, and starting today instead of someday.
